## Studio Production & Engineering Stack
- Studio Video: Elgato Facecam MK1, Samsung A52s, dedicated 1080p60 multi-channel capture/streaming workstation (Intel i7-7700, NVIDIA Quadro T400)
- Field Video: Samsung S24 Ultra with Blackmagic Cam (4K60 open-gate 160Mbps H.265, hardware noise reduction and sharpening off), Xiaomi 15T Pro for short-form video
- Audio: Focusrite Vocaster One, modified Genesis Radium 300 XLR microphone, controlled acoustic treatment and adjustable studio lighting
- Post-Production: DaVinci Resolve Studio (4K60 YouTube standard, 4K25 concert footage, 1080p30 vertical, DNxHR HQX masters), LumaFusion, OBS Studio, Subtitle Edit
- Graphics & Artwork: Clip Studio Paint (100% human-made digital artwork, creator retains full copyright)
- Local AI Tooling: Local models via LM Studio and DaVinci neural engine used strictly for masking, tracking, and preliminary script translation under human verification
- Web Infrastructure: Cloudflare Edge, GitHub repositories with automated deployment, Lark Suite workspace, Visual Studio 2026, Android Studio, Antigravity 2.0
